D: An oxygen tank blows three days out, the Moon landing is off, and three astronauts ride a freezing lunar module home while Houston works the problem.
P: Serve the brisket when Lovell tells Houston they have a problem.
S: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes, then cool in iced water. Peel and halve the eggs and mash the yolks with the mayo, mustard, vinegar and salt. Pipe or spoon back into the whites, dust with paprika and scatter with chives.
Square-peg ravioli in a round bowl
Houston fits a square filter in a round hole

Simmer the stock with the parmesan and garlic for 10 minutes, then fish out the rind. Drop in the ravioli and cook until they float. Ladle into round bowls, add a squeeze of lemon, oil, basil and grated parmesan.
375g fresh square ricotta and spinach ravioli@Deli
40g parmesan rind or block, plus extra to grate@Dairy
M: Houston, we have a problem smoked brisket
Lovell radios Houston with the problem

Rub the brisket all over with the pepper, salt, paprika and garlic powder. Sit it fat side up in a roasting tin, pour the stock around, cover tightly with foil and cook at 140C. Uncover and roast at 200C until the bark darkens. Rest for 20 minutes, then slice across the grain. Serve with white bread, pickles, onion and barbecue sauce.

Brown the chicken in the butter, then add the leek and carrot and cook until soft. Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream, and simmer until thick. Stir in the peas, season and spoon into 4 pie dishes. Top with pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
W: Nobody knows if the heat shield held

Warm the cream with the vanilla seeds and pod until steaming, then take off the heat. Whisk the yolks and 80g sugar, then whisk in the cream and strain into 4 ramekins. Bake in a water bath at 150C until just set with a wobble, then chill. Sprinkle each with sugar and scorch with a blowtorch or under a hot grill until dark amber.
80g caster sugar, plus 4 tbsp for the tops@Pantry
K: Lovell isn't used to the champagne
Drop a sugar cube into each of 4 flutes and shake a dash of bitters onto each. Top slowly with the cold sparkling and add a twist of orange peel.
